steps.title: Discovery & reconciliation
steps.capability: Read-only subscription inventory and optional state reconciliation
steps.value: An operator can inventory Foundry, Key Vault, and registry resources in a chosen subscription without a JAWS state file. Supplying a state file reconciles the named resources. Discover does not change Azure or the state file.
steps.evidence: Pester covers empty inventory, unclaimed rows, tenant mismatch, reconciliation, and Test-JawsStepADiscovery.ps1. A live Discover in a new subscription has not been recorded, so that run is BLOCKED.
